dispositions.statement: The flagged rows are VardimanBlack's term loan and delayed draw, printed 'SOFR + 2.00 % PIK + 5.00 % [Fixed] R %': a PIK leg floating at SOFR + 2.00 and a fixed 5.00 cash leg. Under orchestrator decision D-218 the build publishes basis_spread 2.00, pik_rate = R - 5.00 (the whole PIK coupon, as for whole-coupon PIK loans) and the printed all-in rate, so the cash leg is 5.00. The rule compares pik_rate with the 2.00 margin printed before the word PIK. No fix applies: publishing 2.00 as pik_rate overstates the cash leg by about 4.65 points.

dispositions.statement: The six flagged rows are the Kent Water Sports first-out and last-out delayed draw loans, printed 'SOFR + 9.00 % PIK 14.44 %' and 'SOFR + 10.00 % PIK 15.44 %': the whole coupon is paid in kind. The build publishes pik_rate = the printed coupon (whole-coupon convention, D-092 and the BCRED 'SOFR + 11.00 % 16.57 % PIK' correction) with the margin as basis_spread; the rule compares pik_rate with the margin printed before the word PIK. No fix applies: publishing the margin as pik_rate would leave a cash leg on a loan that pays none and break the series with 2024-09-30 onward, printed with a floor and published the same way.
